lessons.trigger_condition: V412 safely added six TCG categories, but market/release/purchase coverage still contained core-three assumptions, promoted categories lacked periodic source evidence, and watch candidates had no evidence-derived activation path. V413 moves category surfaces to the registry, promotes Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh! and Digimon from verified evidence, monitors promoted and watch non-core games through bounded registry URLs, and lets verified official/market depth/organized-play/collectibility/region evidence drive bounded promotion decisions.
lessons.prevention_rule: Monitor promoted and watch non-core registry official/market URLs with bounded public-HTTPS requests. Update only declarative evidence, preserve prior verified depth on outages, calculate category activation from verified official evidence, independent market evidence, organized play, collectibility, catalog depth, signal diversity and region coverage, then require the configured score+signal+official+market+depth gates before promotion. Never use price direction, expected profit or user behavior. Keep grading false until separate calibration; keep eight mandatory collectors and 17→12→18 screen neural unchanged.

lessons.safety_boundary: V413 expands verified declarative market categories and removes remaining core-three UI/purchase assumptions. It does not guarantee profit, predict future prices, auto-enable grading for uncalibrated games, execute arbitrary generated code, rewrite runtime source autonomously, write Git/main, or treat repository tests as proof of physical Lenovo execution.
